en: The postcard depicts a large, ornate school building with multiple windows and decorative architectural elements, set behind a fence with some young trees in front. To the right is a round water tower. There is a grassy area with laundry hanging in the foreground. The color is sepia-toned, and the image is likely from the early 20th century. The text indicates this is the 'Knaben-Bürgerschule mit Wasserturm' (Boys' Civic School with Water Tower) in Wurzen.
